channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Sep 14
item.description:
72 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 3 HRS

  • Lamb and calf corpses no longer yield resources when killed.

Animals & Farming

  • Lamb and calf corpses no longer yield resources when killed.
  • Attacking farm animals flags you as hostile to the safezone, affecting safezone entry.
  • Livestock critter population settings adjusted, altering spawn numbers.
  • Animals near vehicles now interact correctly; sheep prefab updated.
  • Mounting support added for Gen2 AI via NPCMountable component (currently teleports on mount).

Fencing & Structures

  • Fence gate opening/closing speed halved, making gates operate more slowly.
  • Fences can now be demolished with a hammer, show a blue highlight when demolishable, and include door controller sockets on gates.

Combat

  • Combat hit detection improvements: cleaver melee range corrected and hitbox collision fixed, improving reach and hit registration.

Cooking & Food

  • Cooking system expanded: raw beef now correctly cooks into cooked beef and new meat types added to all oven prefabs.

UI & Input

  • UI fixes: key input latching resolved (F1 console no longer opens unintentionally) and map screen now includes a functional close button.

Admin Commands

  • Scrap King console command restored with description and grade for the foundation block.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Squirrels now avoid entering riverside and oceanside areas, preventing them from wandering into water bodies.

Bug Fixes

  • Resolved a gamepad-specific issue where closing the menu during key assignment could corrupt bindings, ensuring key assignments persist correctly.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Sep 13
item.description:
